name: VOD
description: Follow YouTube, Twitch and other online channels from Jellyfin: their videos appear in a library and are streamed on demand through yt-dlp, with nothing downloaded to disk.
overview: Virtual VOD channel/playlist library via yt-dlp

versions.changelog:
- YouTube videos now play on Android and TV without crashing: trailing SEI NAL units are stripped.
- The database is rebuilt on first start: every video is re-fetched from its platform, so expect a long first run. Your watch history reattaches as each video comes back.
- A run now finishes one source before moving to the next, instead of leaving every source half-resolved.
- Failures carry the platform's own explanation instead of the word "Failed".
- A video that keeps failing is retried further and further apart, so one broken video can no longer get you rate-limited.
- Each source gets a detail panel: its five stages, what happened to each video, and buttons to retry one or all of them.
- The page warns you when your cookie session has expired, or when a setting would silently stop all listing.

- A channel whose handle carries an accent no longer shares its series with another channel: its videos move to a series of their own on the next sync.
- The configuration page warns when two sources would publish into the same series instead of letting them overwrite each other silently.
- A series now wears the thumbnail of its most recent video rather than the channel avatar, which reads better in Jellyfin's interface.

- Picking a quality no longer forces a software transcode: the tier is streamed as a direct copy.
- A source appears complete, its episodes in chronological order, once all of its videos resolve.
- Switching a source between series and movies now takes effect.
- The configuration page shows how far each source has got.
- Enumeration no longer fetches metadata video by video: it runs in bounded waves, one source at a time.
- First fill is gradual, and a source stays hidden until every one of its videos has resolved.

- First release.
- Follow YouTube, Twitch and Arte channels, tabs, playlists and single videos as series or movies.
- Stream on demand through yt-dlp, with nothing stored on disk.
- Quality versions, described ahead of playback so Jellyfin copies instead of transcoding.
- Multiple audio and subtitle tracks, named and filtered by preferred language.
- Live broadcasts detected within minutes, turned into replays when they end.
